summary.name: MarkViewer
summary.one_liner: A free, native macOS Markdown viewer and editor that renders GitHub-flavored Markdown with live WYSIWYG editing and works fully offline.
use_cases: Reviewing changes made by AI coding agents
Reading local documentation while traveling offline
summary.what_it_does:
MarkViewer opens .md and .markdown files on macOS and renders GitHub-flavored Markdown, including tables, task lists, and syntax-highlighted code blocks. Its editor applies formatting as you type Markdown syntax (WYSIWYG). It auto-generates a table of contents from headings, supports multiple tabs and windows, and includes a file finder, a built-in terminal, and find-and-highlight search. An optional AI section lets you annotate passages and either hand prompts to an AI tool or run the locally installed Claude Code or Codex CLI, with a diff review before changes are applied. The page says all processing happens locally with no account or cloud sync.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Native macOS app with Universal Binary for Intel and Apple Silicon
Works fully offline with no account, cloud sync, or API key needed for core features
Auto table of contents from headings and multi-tab editing
Optional AI review loop that drives locally installed Claude Code or Codex CLI, with diff review before applying changes
caveats: Agent features depend on Claude Code or Codex CLI already being installed on the Mac
Desktop app includes opt-in analytics (disabled by default)
